item: fixedb_jacobian_v1 (initial-scope stdlib probe, pure-Python float complex; validation, NOT a search)
admission: initial scope: frozen <=300 s stdlib probe, single process, <=256 MiB RSS, <=16 MiB output; no numpy/native; PID recorded by the wrapper before compute; launch-record path+sha sent to parent at launch
purpose: validate the residual and analytic Jacobian of the proposed fixed-B unitary model (q_ij = U_i e_j, U_0 = I, zero-diagonal skew-Hermitian charts) by exact-for-quadratics central differences at random unitaries (cyclic v=4,5,7; XOR v=8) and at the exact anchors; float residual/Gram/rays at the anchors; numerical rank / kernel / gauge / excess at the v=7 Huang-Li and v=8 Zhang-Cao anchors and at a classical cyclic v=7 point
wrapper: /bin/bash -c 'echo START date PID $$ PGID; exec /usr/bin/env -i TMPDIR=<lane>/tmp <argv>' (exec keeps the PID)
self_time_guard: tangent stages skipped (SKIPPED_TIME recorded) once 200 s have elapsed
